WILDSIGNAL — The forest is listening
An original browser wilderness expedition.

ENVIRONMENT
Terrain, forest layout, procedural trees, canopy art, grass, landmarks, equipment,
flowers, fireflies, storm wisps, shaders and gameplay created for this game.

SCANNED ASSETS — POLY HAVEN (CC0)
Forest Floor — https://polyhaven.com/a/forest_floor
Bark Brown 02 — https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_brown_02
Mossy Rock — https://polyhaven.com/a/mossy_rock
Fern 02 — https://polyhaven.com/a/fern_02
Rock Moss Set 01 — https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_moss_set_01
Asset license: https://polyhaven.com/license
CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Files are bundled locally; these assets do not require a third-party service to play.

RENDERER
Three.js r170 — https://threejs.org — MIT license.
Copyright 2010-2024 Three.js Authors. Full license in vendor/LICENSE.txt.

SOUND
Original procedural ambient sound, birds, footsteps and signal effects generated
in the browser with Web Audio. No external audio files.

INSPIRATION
Electric Dreams Environment by Epic Games:
https://www.unrealengine.com/electric-dreams-environment
Wildsignal is a separate browser game. It does not contain the Electric Dreams
project, any of its UE-only assets, or the original 4 x 4 km level. It is not
affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games.

GAMEPLAY
Restore three relays, then hold E at Base Camp to transmit your rescue signal.
Expedition mode: eight-minute deadline, storm wisps, survival resources.
Wander mode: no time limit and no damage; all exploration and relay goals remain.
Controls: WASD move; mouse or drag look; Shift sprint; Space jump; E interact;
Q firefly pulse; F echo lure; M field map; P photo view; Escape pause.
Progress and settings are saved in this browser's local storage.
